sloka: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः ।प्रचुक्रुशुर् महात्मानो हृष्टाः शत सहस्रशः ॥४-२६-३७॥
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve sarve vānara puṁgavāḥ ।pracukruśur mahātmāno hṛṣṭāḥ śata sahasraśaḥ ॥4-26-37॥

translations.english: As Sugriva was ceremoniously consecrated, thousands of monkeys rejoiced and shrieked out of joy.
